goal: repair and freeze the merged Stage15 R01 theorem content as one proof-facing self-contained offline HTML review artifact under the project-wide Stage12/13/14 standard, without assuming an unrecorded Stage15-7 audit closure

stage15_r01_provenance_status.stage15_8_policy: Treat merged R01 as a synthesis source candidate and independently fresh-audit R02 against the immediate canonical mathematical sources. Do not invent a retrospective Stage15-7 closure and do not reopen Stage15-7 mathematics.

scope_rule: Stage15-8 is a presentation, preservation, provenance-repair, and hostile-review stage. It may repair omitted proof transcription, theorem-contract mapping, provenance, or offline presentation, but it must not strengthen the mathematics, reopen Stage15-6/7, invent a retrospective Stage15-7 audit closure, or invent a new Stage15 theorem.

command_semantics.Stage15-8-main-batch: Build or repair the self-contained Stage15 HTML from the merged Stage15 R01 synthesis candidate and immediate canonical proof sources. Do not assume R01 is canonically audited or Stage15-7 is CLOSED unless a canonical audit/closeout record exists. Apply docs/self-contained-review-standard.md. Embed every Stage15-internal load-bearing proof or adapter needed for the final implication chain; a repository path alone is provenance, not proof. Published external theorems may remain external only with exact working forms, hypothesis maps, height/measure adapters, and quantifier/uniformity limits. Preserve theorem species, populations, cutoff, provenance, finite-evidence discipline, and non-claims. Keep the artifact offline-capable. Repair the existing Draft PR; the main operator cannot approve its own PR.
command_semantics.Stage15-8-audit: Fresh read-only ChatGPT audit of the latest Stage15-8 Draft PR. Treat docs/self-contained-review-standard.md as authoritative. Compare every load-bearing HTML implication against the merged R01 synthesis candidate and the immediate canonical mathematical sources; do not rely on an unsupported Stage15-7 AUDITED/CLOSED_R01 premise. Verify that internal proof steps are embedded rather than merely cited, verify external theorem working contracts and hypothesis maps, inspect offline self-containment and provenance consistency, and return the exact audit footer. Do not modify files.

required_before_stop: external theorem working-form and hypothesis-map audit
Stage15-5 versus Stage15-6 theorem-species separation audit
population, multiplicity, canonical convention, and R<=B cutoff audit
local-density derivation and ordered-limit quantifier audit
html_constraints: single HTML file is understandable without repository browsing for every load-bearing implication in the Stage15 proof chain
Stage15-internal geometry, height adapters, multiplicity, exact normal form, local-density computation, and fixed-S adapter are embedded in proof-complete form
completed Stage14 theorem may remain a frozen upstream interface because population/cutoff/multiplicity match is explicit
published external theorem proofs need not be embedded, but exact working forms, hypotheses, object/measure adapters, quantifier order, and non-uniformity boundaries must be printed
no required external images or other assets
repository paths may be printed as provenance text but cannot substitute for load-bearing proof

html_claim_firewalls: Stage15-5 fixed-power survival bound is sourced from the Stage14 numerator theorem plus the Stage15-2b denominator
Stage15-6 independently proves qualitative zero density from the local squareclass sieve and does not internally recover the half-power rate
Stage15-6 proves no internal fixed delta>0 and no sigma>0
finite Stage15-3 counts are diagnostic and are not promoted to an asymptotic
zero density of the exactly-two survivor population does not prove perfect-cuboid existence or nonexistence
future effective growing-modulus or global-correlation mechanisms are external future gates, not unfinished Stage15-6 work
summary-only prose plus repository paths is not accepted as self-contained when the omitted step is load-bearing
an unrecorded chat audit or intended closeout is not a canonical repository audit status
required_html_sections: relation to the perfect cuboid problem
fresh audit checklist and machine-readable lock

required_checks: claim-by-claim equivalence with the merged Stage15 R01 synthesis candidate and immediate canonical mathematical sources
Stage15-2a/2b geometry, exact height, thin-cover and ambient proof transcription
Stage15-4 G normalization, inverse multiplicity, height identity and squareclass proof transcription
Stage15-6dy split-prime divisor ledger, tube probabilities and rho_p derivation
Stage15-6dz fixed-S same-measure adapter, tensor product and ordered limits
external theorem working forms, hypotheses, measure/height adapters and uniformity limits
offline self-containment and absence of required external assets

verdict_semantics.PASS: The HTML satisfies the project-wide self-contained review standard, faithfully represents the canonical Stage15 theorem content without relying on an unsupported Stage15-7 audit closure, and may merge if deterministic verification also passes.
verdict_semantics.FIX_REQUIRED: Repair the HTML/controller/verifier/manifest/provenance in the same Stage15-8 main line; do not open a new mathematical route.
verdict_semantics.BLOCKED: A missing or contradictory canonical Stage15 dependency prevents a faithful self-contained freeze. State the exact blocker.

audit_contract.internal_route_remains_semantics: For Stage15-8, INTERNAL_ROUTE_REMAINS means an unresolved proof-transcription, external-contract, HTML, preservation, provenance, or presentation gap. It never authorizes a new Stage15-6 or Stage15-7 mathematical route.

close_only_if: the self-contained HTML exists and passes offline-asset verification
the HTML embeds every current-Stage load-bearing internal proof required by the final implication chain
external published theorem interfaces include working forms and hypothesis maps
the HTML faithfully preserves the canonical Stage15 theorem species and non-claims without relying on an unsupported Stage15-7 AUDITED/CLOSED_R01 premise
closure_contract.after_close: Freeze the R02 HTML as the human-facing Stage15 review artifact. Any new mathematics belongs to a later research program, not Stage15-8.

codex_transfer_triggers: large mechanical HTML repair beyond reliable connector editing
CI or verifier failure requiring repository-wide diagnosis
source volume cannot be inspected reliably in one fresh ChatGPT audit
codex_non_triggers: ordinary PR updates through the GitHub connector
merge_rule: MERGE_ALLOWED only when dedicated verification passes and a fresh Stage15-8-audit returns PASS. Main-batch cannot approve its own PR.
